correctness.rationale: The 16-vertex 4-dimensional hypercube Q4 (isomorphic as graph to C4□C4, a 4×4 toroidal grid) has independent-set masks exactly those with no Hamming-distance-one pair. An independent exhaustive enumeration over all 2^16 subsets gives the 742 nonempty faces and f=(16,88,208,228,128,56,16,2). Independently reconstructed 367 vertex-toggle cover matches and all 2816 Hasse arrows; complete topological sorting verifies no directed cycle; critical profile one 0-simplex and seven 3-simplices, so Forman gives wedge of seven S3. Independent GF2 boundary ranks [15,73,135,86,42,14,2] yield reduced beta3=7. The integral homotopy relies on acyclic Morse matching, not merely mod2 ranks.

value.rationale: Independence complexes of canonical hypercubes and small fully periodic square grids are natural benchmarks; exact integral homotopy is substantially stronger than the known hard-square alternating count or mere suspension, and identifies seven 3-sphere summands in the canonical doubly-periodic 4×4 case. The complete finite Morse classification is a motivated exact invariant useful independently of a general torus-family theorem.

scientific_limitations: One finite 4-cube; no uniform family formula.
Do not infer integral homotopy from binary Betti alone: matching proves it.
A less-indexed complete toroidal 4×4 hard-square or Q4 exact topology calculation could already give the wedge; Jonsson full toroidal paper was not fully material-read here.
